Definition: Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Heber = "comrade"; 1) the Kenite, husband of Jael, who slew Sisera by driving a nail into his temple; 2) grandson of Asher from whom came the Heberites; 3) father of Socho, a Judahite; 4) a Benjamite; 5) another Benjamite; 6) a Gadite
